notes: Command syntax from the vendor protocol doc and default_config.txt. 'verified' = tested live over USB on this build. 'noAck' = the firmware runs it but answers in the log or to the server, never with AT RETURN. Every keyword here is present in this build's parser table. Fields: 'from' names the ts/getapn value that pre-fills it. Left out on purpose: tsext prints its reply and then reboots this build (pwon_count 17 to 18, no AT RETURN). presets is a list of named setups; each step names a setting id and the field values to write. Add another object there to get another button. A setting with reboot true makes the page wait for USB to return before the next step.

presets.label: Vodafone SME
presets.help: The setup that works on these IoT SIMs: APN sme.vodafone.iot with no user or password, home network 90128, and the vendor server. The tracker reboots after the APN; the server is written once USB is back.
presets.confirm: Write the Vodafone SME APN and the vendor server? The tracker reboots after the APN.

settings.label: APN
settings.help: Data network the SIM uses. MCCMNC is the SIM's home network from its IMSI (90128 for the Vodafone IoT SIM). The tracker reboots after saving.

settings.label: Server
settings.help: Platform the tracker reports to. Use the IP rather than the hostname on private APNs. Vendor: 47.106.163.223 port 8888.

settings.label: Upload interval
settings.help: Seconds between position reports. Vendor recommends 600; 60 only while searching for an animal, it drains the battery.

settings.label: Data and GPS
settings.help: Off puts the tracker in deep sleep: no data, no GPS, so the platform cannot reach it. USB still works.
settings.confirm: With data off the platform can no longer reach this tracker. Continue?

settings.label: Automatic reboot
settings.help: Factory default is on, every 1440 minutes (daily).

settings.label: Center number
settings.help: The phone that sends SMS commands. Needs an SMS-capable SIM in the tracker to matter.

settings.label: SOS numbers
settings.help: Up to three numbers alerted on an SOS alarm.

settings.label: SMS password
settings.confirm: Write the new password down first. Continue?

settings.label: Do not disturb
settings.help: On: only center and SOS numbers may call the tracker.

settings.label: Removal alarm
settings.help: Factory default is off. The sensor arms 3 minutes after power on.

settings.label: Language and time zone
settings.help: Factory default is UTC+8 (China). Portugal is 0 in winter, 1 in summer.

settings.label: Status
settings.help: Firmware, server, numbers, interval, time zone, network.

settings.label: Network info
settings.help: Logs IMSI, PLMN and data attach state.

settings.label: SIM ICCID
settings.help: Look for read_iccid in the log.

settings.label: GSM signal
settings.help: Answers to the server; the log shows gsmsignal,<0-100>.

settings.label: Force GPS fix
settings.help: Wakes GPS and uploads every 30 s for 3 minutes.

settings.label: Reboot
settings.confirm: Reboot the tracker? USB drops and comes back in about 30 seconds.

settings.label: Power off
settings.confirm: Power the tracker off? You will need the button to turn it back on.

settings.label: Factory reset
settings.confirm: Factory reset sets the APN back to Tele2 and the time zone to UTC+8. You must re-send APN and server afterwards. Continue?
